watch.summary: While hyping himself up for a late-game comeback in Rocket League, the streamer accidentally scores an own goal instead.

beats.what: Streamer hypes himself up down 9-5 with 17 seconds remaining.
Declares 'If there's anyone who could do it to you, bro...'
Accidentally pinches the ball directly into his own goal.
Bursts out laughing and buries his face in his hands at the irony.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: If there's anyone who could do it to you, bro.
watch.why: The textbook setup of immense self-belief immediately followed by a catastrophic self-sabotage creates instant comedic irony. His genuine laughter and head-in-hands disbelief make the clip universally funny even to non-gamers.
